name: Aceternity UI
one_liner: 200+ animated React and Tailwind components, shadcn-compatible blocks, and templates including portfolios, with a paid All-Access tier.
reason: Popular flashy hero effects, bento grids and portfolio templates, with an MCP server for coding agents; distinct from existing component records.

name: Magic UI
one_liner: 150+ free open-source animated React, TypeScript, Tailwind and Motion components, plus paid Pro blocks and templates.
reason: Widely used shadcn-compatible animated sections and templates suited to code-built portfolios; standalone product even though 21st.dev also lists it.

name: React Bits
one_liner: Large free collection of animated React text effects, backgrounds and interactive components, installable via shadcn or jsrepo CLI.
reason: Live and widely used for expressive portfolio heroes and text animation; not covered by existing component libraries.

name: Readymag
one_liner: Browser design tool for building art-directed, editorial, typography-led websites without code.
reason: Widely used by designers for distinctive portfolio sites and case studies; strong no-code alternative to Framer with a different editorial approach.

name: Recent (formerly Godly)
one_liner: Curated gallery of standout websites plus branding, typography and motion work; godly.website now redirects here.
reason: High-signal, frequently updated showcase of distinctive sites, ideal for portfolio layout and motion inspiration; confirmed godly.website 301s here. Sponsor ads mention agents, not injection.

name: Siteinspire
one_liner: Long-running curated web design showcase filterable by style, type (including Portfolio) and subject, updated several times weekly.
reason: Has a dedicated Portfolio type filter plus typographic and minimal style tags, directly useful for portfolio reference; calmer complement to Awwwards and Muzli.

name: Spline
one_liner: Browser-based collaborative 3D design with interactivity and AI, exporting embeds for web, React, Next.js, Framer and Webflow.
reason: Standard tool for interactive 3D portfolio heroes that works with both code and no-code builders; not in the library.

name: v0 by Vercel
one_liner: Prompt-to-app agent that generates Next.js, React, Tailwind and shadcn/ui code with previews and one-click Vercel deploys.
reason: Generates a portfolio site in the exact React/Next/Tailwind stack many builders use, with editable code and instant hosting; distinct product from 21st, Variant or Manus.

name: Webflow
one_liner: Visual site builder with CMS, GSAP-powered interactions, hosting, templates and AI/MCP tooling, plus a free starter tier.
reason: One of the main no-code platforms for designer portfolios and client sites, with a strong CMS for case studies. Framer's rival, not a duplicate.

name: Adobe Color
one_liner: Free palette tool with color-wheel harmonies, image palette and gradient extraction, contrast checker and trending themes.
reason: Builds a portfolio color system from a photo or harmony rule and checks accessible contrast; free to use, account only needed to save to libraries.

name: Animata
one_liner: Hundreds of MIT-licensed, copy-paste animated React components built with Tailwind CSS for Next.js.
reason: Free drop-in animated text, cards and backgrounds for a React/Tailwind portfolio; WebFetch 403 but site returns 200 to browsers. Distinct from FeralUI.

name: Animate UI
one_liner: Open-source (MIT) animated React components built on shadcn/ui, Radix, Tailwind and Motion, installed via the shadcn CLI.
reason: Copy-in animated components for React/Next.js portfolios; same stack as Motion-Primitives but a separate project with its own component set.

name: Atropos
one_liner: Lightweight MIT JavaScript library for touch-friendly 3D parallax tilt effects; vanilla, React and Web Components builds.
reason: Adds layered 3D hover depth to project cards and hero images on web portfolios; the existing flutter_tilt record is Flutter-only.

name: awesome-design-md (VoltAgent)
one_liner: MIT GitHub collection of 70+ DESIGN.md files based on well-known brand sites, meant to steer AI coding agents' UI output.
reason: Free, widely starred files you drop into a repo so AI agents build a portfolio in a consistent visual style; separate from designmd.app.

name: Bolt.new
one_liner: Browser-based AI builder that generates full-stack websites and apps from prompts, with hosting, databases and custom domains.
reason: A common prompt-to-site route for building and hosting a portfolio quickly; a separate product from Manus.

name: CSS Design Awards
one_liner: Juried web design awards with a daily Website of the Day, UI/UX/innovation scores and nominee galleries.
reason: Active, curated source of standout sites, including portfolios and studio sites; a separate awards body from Awwwards.

name: Fancy Components
one_liner: Free, open-source React component library of playful microinteractions: image trails, gravity physics, text highlighters, path marquees.
reason: Free copy-paste React motion components that add personality to portfolio heroes and project pages; distinct product from FeralUI with a larger catalog.

name: Fonts In Use
one_liner: Independent archive of 34,000+ real-world typography uses, indexed by typeface, format (including web) and topic.
reason: Helps choose and pair typefaces by seeing them in real identities and websites; no typography archive exists in the library.

name: footer.design
one_liner: Free curated gallery of website footer designs, filterable by style such as typographic, animated, large type and dark.
reason: Focused section-level inspiration for the portfolio footer and contact area; companion to the existing Navbar Gallery, not the same product.

name: Kokonut UI
one_liner: Open-source React, Tailwind and Motion components installable via shadcn CLI and MCP, with a paid Pro tier.
reason: 100+ free animated shadcn-registry components suited to Next.js portfolios built with AI agents; distinct from Cult UI.

name: Land-book
one_liner: Curated gallery of landing pages, portfolios and blogs, filterable by style, color, industry and section.
reason: Returned 403 to the fetcher but search confirms it is active; dedicated Portfolios category, free Basic plan, Pro about $6/month.

name: LDRS by UI Ball
one_liner: Free open-source set of 50+ customizable loading spinners as web components and React components, installable via npm.
reason: Live, free, npm-installable loaders for page transitions and loading states; distinct from the single-demo Math Curve Loaders record.

name: Locomotive Scroll
one_liner: MIT-licensed scroll library for in-view detection, parallax and smooth scrolling, built on top of Lenis.
reason: Standard tool for scroll-driven portfolio sites. It builds on Lenis but adds in-view and parallax, so it's a separate product.

name: LottieFiles
one_liner: Large free Lottie animation library plus Lottie Creator editor and open-source dotLottie web players.
reason: Homepage returns 403 to automated fetches, but search confirms it is live; lightweight animations and web players suit portfolios and differ from Lottielab.

name: Lovable
one_liner: Prompt-to-app builder generating React, TypeScript, Tailwind and Supabase code with GitHub sync; free tier with daily credits.
reason: 403 to bots, but search confirms it's an active major product. Common way to generate and own a portfolio codebase. Distinct from Manus.

name: Neat Gradients
one_liner: Free animated 3D gradient background generator with presets, exporting code, images or video.
reason: Live and free. Animated hero backgrounds drop straight into portfolio sites. A close alternative to ShaderGradient, not the same product.

name: Onlook
one_liner: Open-source, AI-assisted visual editor that edits real React/Next.js/Vite codebases with drag-and-drop and collaboration.
reason: Lets you design a coded portfolio visually in the real codebase; self-hostable free, code stays yours. Distinct product from Paper.

name: Paper Shaders
one_liner: Zero-dependency shader effects (mesh gradients, dithering, halftone, grain, liquid metal) as React and vanilla packages.
reason: Code library for animated backgrounds and image filters; made by Paper's team but a separate open-source package, not the Paper design canvas (s47).

name: Paper Shaders
one_liner: Apache-2.0, zero-dependency canvas shader effects (mesh gradients, grain, dithering) for vanilla JS and React.
reason: Lightweight animated hero backgrounds installable from npm; open-source library separate from the Paper design app, about 3.4k stars and active.

name: Pen (formerly Pencil)
one_liner: Agentic design canvas with VS Code/Cursor extensions, Figma and web import, and HTML/CSS or Tailwind export.
reason: Design portfolio pages with AI agents inside the IDE and export Tailwind code; live, rebranded from Pencil, competitor to Paper.

name: React Spring
one_liner: MIT spring-physics animation library for React and react-three-fiber, maintained by pmndrs.
reason: Mature, actively maintained (v10.1.2, ~29k stars) open-source option for natural UI motion in React portfolios; different product from Motion.

name: Realtime Colors
one_liner: Free tool that previews palettes and Google Fonts on a live site layout, with contrast checks and CSS/Tailwind export.
reason: Quickly test a portfolio's color and type system on a realistic page and export tokens; free, with a Figma plugin.

name: Rotato
one_liner: Mac app (web beta) that places screens on 30+ 3D device models and animates camera moves up to 8K.
reason: Makes polished device-mockup stills and videos for case studies and project showcases; free trial, paid Pro.

name: shadcn/ui Registry Directory
one_liner: Official index of community shadcn/ui registries, all installable with npx shadcn add @registry/component.
reason: Free, official map to many component libraries that plug into React/Next.js/Tailwind portfolios and agent workflows through a single CLI.

name: shadcnblocks
one_liner: 2,000+ shadcn/ui and Tailwind blocks and components plus templates; free subset, paid one-time tiers from $149.
reason: Actively updated (Aug 2026). Ready-made hero, about, project and contact sections speed up coded portfolios. Mostly paid, with a free tier.

name: Shots
one_liner: Browser tool that turns screenshots into device mockups and animated showcase visuals with backgrounds and export presets.
reason: Directly useful for polished project thumbnails and case-study imagery. Different product from animos.

name: Skiper UI
one_liner: 106+ unusual animated shadcn/ui components built with Tailwind and Motion; some free, premium one-time from $129.
reason: Distinctive motion effects like image reveals and cursor trails suit expressive portfolio pages. Installs via the shadcn registry.

name: Subframe
one_liner: AI-native visual editor that exports React, Radix and Tailwind code and connects to Cursor and Claude Code via MCP.
reason: Lets builders design portfolio pages visually and ship real code into agent workflows. Free tier plus $29/month Pro. Separate product from Paper.

name: The Component Gallery
one_liner: Free reference of 60 UI components with thousands of real examples from 90+ design systems.
reason: Useful when designing portfolio navs, cards, tabs and accordions: it shows how established systems name, structure and document each component. Different from Checklist Design.

name: The FWA
one_liner: Long-running web award site that picks cutting-edge interactive sites daily, including many creative portfolios.
reason: Updated daily (awards dated Sept 2026). Strong inspiration for experimental, interaction-heavy portfolios. A separate product from Awwwards.

name: tints.dev
one_liner: Free generator that turns one hex color into a Tailwind 50-950 palette, with an API and oklch/hex/hsl export.
reason: Directly useful for Tailwind portfolio builds (v3 and v4). A different product from UI Colors that fills a similar role; source code is public.

name: Unicorn Studio
one_liner: No-code editor for layered WebGL effects and interactive scenes that embed live on websites.
reason: Live, distinctive interactive hero backgrounds that embed in code or no-code builders; different product from the existing shader and effect records.

name: VFX-JS
one_liner: JavaScript library that applies WebGL shader effects like glitch, RGB shift and halftone to images, video and text.
reason: Adds distinctive live shader effects and transitions to portfolio images and headings with little code. Fits creative portfolios well; a different product from Effect.app.

name: Wix Studio
one_liner: Agency-focused responsive site builder with no-code animations, CMS, custom code and multi-client management.
reason: A common choice for freelancers and small studios building client portfolio sites. The free tier is unclear from the page.

name: 60fps
one_liner: Curated recordings of 2,000+ UI animations and interactions from iOS apps and web, filterable by gesture, pattern and effect.
reason: Good source of micro-interaction and transition ideas for portfolio polish, though mobile-heavy; broader catalog than Design Spells rather than a duplicate.

name: Are.na
one_liner: Ad-free platform for collecting images, links and notes into shareable channels, with an open API and Premium tier.
reason: Widely used by designers to gather and organize visual references before designing a portfolio; comparable to Cosmos but a distinct long-running product.

name: BP&O (Branding, Packaging and Opinion)
one_liner: Active publication of critical reviews of brand identity and packaging projects, with a large logo archive.
reason: Shows identity designers how strong branding projects are presented and explained, which helps when writing portfolio case studies. Updated September 2026.

name: Brand New (UnderConsideration)
one_liner: Daily reviews of logo and corporate identity redesigns with before-and-after comparisons; some content needs a subscription.
reason: Long-running reference for framing identity work and rebrand rationale in case studies; still updated daily in September 2026.

name: BUCK
one_liner: Site of a global animation, design and brand studio, with a work grid and detailed client case-study pages.
reason: A strong example of how a studio portfolio structures its work grid and case studies; similar in role to the Warm & Fuzzy record.

name: Calligraphr
one_liner: Web app that turns handwriting drawn on printed templates into downloadable fonts; free plan plus paid tiers.
reason: Lets you make a custom handwritten font for a personal-brand portfolio; a separate tool from Doodle Fonts.

name: Colormind
one_liner: Free deep-learning color palette generator with locked colors, image extraction, UI template previews and an API.
reason: The page returned 403 to the fetcher, but search confirms it is live. Previewing palettes on a UI template helps pick portfolio colors.

name: CSS Loaders
one_liner: 600+ free single-element pure-CSS loading animations in 40+ categories; click a loader to copy its CSS.
reason: Copy-ready preloaders and loading states for portfolio sites; a much larger, general-purpose set than the Math Curve Loaders record.

name: DESIGN.md spec (google-labs-code)
one_liner: Apache-2.0 DESIGN.md format spec and CLI to lint contrast, diff, and export tokens to Tailwind or DTCG.
reason: Official format behind DESIGN.md libraries; lets agent-built portfolios keep tokens consistent and export to Tailwind. Alpha, format may change.

name: Dither it!
one_liner: Free in-browser image dithering with Floyd-Steinberg, Atkinson and Bayer algorithms, custom palettes and animated GIF support.
reason: Quick, free, local way to give project thumbnails and hero images a dithered retro treatment; focused tool not covered by existing records.

name: Fontself
one_liner: Paid Illustrator/Photoshop extension and iPad app that turns hand lettering or vector shapes into OpenType fonts.
reason: Lets designers turn their own lettering into a signature display font for a portfolio wordmark or headings; active, paid, requires Adobe or iPad.

name: FontStruct
one_liner: Free browser editor for building geometric, modular fonts from shapes, exporting TrueType, with a large community gallery.
reason: Free way to make a custom pixel or geometric display typeface for a portfolio; check each shared font's license before using gallery fonts.

name: getdesign.md
one_liner: VoltAgent catalog of 550+ DESIGN.md files extracted from real sites, for handing design references to AI coding agents.
reason: Useful style references for portfolios built with Claude Code, Cursor or Codex; separate product from designmd.app, with freemium catalog pass options.

name: Google Stitch
one_liner: Google's AI tool that generates UI designs from prompts, with Figma and code export and DESIGN.md support.
reason: Free way to explore portfolio layouts and design systems before coding; related to but distinct from Variant and the DESIGN.md library.

name: Hero Patterns
one_liner: Free repeatable SVG background patterns by Steve Schoger with color and opacity controls and copy-ready CSS, CC BY 4.0.
reason: Drop-in CSS/SVG backgrounds for section textures on a portfolio; older collection but live, free and attribution-licensed, distinct from Pattern Club.

name: Jitter
one_liner: Browser motion design tool with templates, AI generation and timeline control, exporting video, GIF and Lottie.
reason: Useful for animated case-study mockups and UI motion clips; separate product from Lottielab and Rive.

name: Khroma
one_liner: Free AI color tool that learns preferred colors in-browser and generates searchable palettes with contrast ratings and CSS.
reason: Handy for choosing a personal portfolio color scheme with accessibility ratings; different product from Picular or UI Colors.

name: Krea
one_liner: Creative AI suite to generate, edit, upscale and enhance images and video across multiple models, with a free tier.
reason: Useful for generating hero visuals, backgrounds and upscaled project imagery; separate product from Higgsfield and Figma Weave already listed.

name: Laws of UX
one_liner: Free illustrated collection of 30+ psychology-based UX principles like Hick's, Fitts's and Jakob's Law.
reason: Grounds portfolio layout choices and gives case studies a shared vocabulary for explaining design decisions; complements Checklist Design.

name: Leonardo (Adobe)
one_liner: Adobe's open-source tool that generates accessible color scales and themes from target contrast ratios, exporting CSS and tokens.
reason: Live and free; helps build an accessible light/dark palette for a portfolio. Contrast-driven approach differs from UI Colors.

name: Letterform Archive Online Archive
one_liner: High-resolution scans of 3,500+ historic lettering, typography, poster and book-design items, browsable by designer, decade and format.
reason: Museum-grade typographic reference for art-directing an editorial or type-led portfolio; maintenance banner in HTML is hidden by default, site responds 200.

name: Magic Patterns
one_liner: AI tool that turns prompts into high-fidelity UI prototypes, importing design-system rules; free tier plus paid seats.
reason: Live, has a free tier, and generates on-brand UI a builder can export. It's aimed at product teams but works for portfolio layouts. Separate from Variant.

name: ManvsMachine
one_liner: London and LA design, film and motion studio whose site showcases award-winning video-led work.
reason: Live, well-known motion studio site. Good reference for showing video-heavy case studies in a studio portfolio.

name: Mesher by CSS Hero
one_liner: Free browser tool for designing mesh gradients and exporting them as pure CSS.
reason: Live, free, and outputs CSS you can paste straight into hero backgrounds. Separate from the FeralUI gradient builder.

name: Milanote
one_liner: Visual board tool for collecting images, notes and links into moodboards and project plans, with a free plan.
reason: Live and useful for setting visual direction and outlining case-study content before building. Covers what Niice was used for.

name: Neutral Studio
one_liner: Small creative agency's portfolio site showing art-directed digital, brand and campaign work.
reason: Live, minimal small-studio portfolio by the agency behind Warm & Fuzzy. Good reference for small-studio sites.

name: Open Peeps
one_liner: CC0 hand-drawn, mix-and-match character illustration library by Pablo Stanley, in SVG and PNG.
reason: Free commercial-use people illustrations for about pages and case-study visuals; separate product from Humaaans with a sketchier style.

name: Pattern Monster
one_liner: Customizable seamless SVG pattern generator with SVG and CSS export and a Pro tier.
reason: Quick copy-paste background textures for sections; a separate tool from Pattern Club and fffuel.

name: play.core (ASCII Play)
one_liner: Browser live-coding playground and engine for real-time ASCII and text-mode generative animations, with many examples.
reason: Niche but useful for code-driven ASCII hero effects on creative developer portfolios; examples are a strong starting point. No license shown.

name: Public Domain Image Archive
one_liner: Public Domain Review's curated archive of 11,000+ out-of-copyright images, browsable by artist, century, style and theme.
reason: Free, reusable historical imagery for textures, moodboards and editorial portfolio visuals; separate searchable image database, not a sub-page of PDR Collections.

name: react-parallax-tilt
one_liner: Zero-dependency 2.9kB React component for tilt, glare and parallax hover effects, with gyroscope support.
reason: npm blocks bots, but search confirms the package is live (~16k weekly downloads). Easy tilt effect for project cards; web counterpart to flutter_tilt.

name: Runway
one_liner: AI platform for generating and editing video, images and audio (Gen-4.5), with a developer API.
reason: Useful for hero loops, showreel clips and motion visuals on portfolio sites; paid tiers with a free trial, broader than portfolio work.

name: SaaS Landing Page
one_liner: Gallery of about 960 real SaaS and startup landing pages, filterable by section type, tech stack, and templates.
reason: Live (search confirms; fetch 403). Useful for hero, feature and pricing section patterns, especially product-builder portfolios. SaaS-focused, so only a partial portfolio fit.

name: Savee
one_liner: Ad-free visual bookmarking and discovery platform with boards, image search, browser extension and Figma integration; freemium.
reason: Strong graphic and web design corpus for moodboarding a portfolio direction. Similar in role to Cosmos but a separate product.

name: Smithsonian Open Access
one_liner: Millions of CC0 2D and 3D images and data from Smithsonian museums with a free public API.
reason: Live (search confirms; fetch 403). CC0 images can be used commercially with no attribution, handy for editorial texture and imagery. Complements Public Domain Review without duplicating it.

name: Storyset
one_liner: Free customizable illustrations in five styles with color and background editing, animation, and a Figma plugin.
reason: Works for 404, empty-state or service illustrations on client and studio portfolios. The stock look and free-tier attribution requirement limit it.

name: SVG Backgrounds
one_liner: Customizable, lightweight SVG backgrounds, patterns and icons with copy-paste CSS; free set plus premium subscription.
reason: Live (search confirms; fetch 403). Quick on-brand section backgrounds with code-ready export. Overlaps Haikei in purpose but is a different product.

name: The Brand Identity
one_liner: Curated publication of standout brand and graphic design projects, interviews, typefaces, a shop and design jobs.
reason: Live (search confirms; fetch 403). Good reference for how studios present identity case studies, and for typography and art direction on design portfolios.

name: tsParticles
one_liner: MIT-licensed particle engine for backgrounds, confetti and fireworks, with React, Vue, Svelte and vanilla packages.
reason: Well-maintained, production-ready way to add particle hero backgrounds or effects. It is a code library, unlike the Casberry AI simulator, so not a duplicate.

name: unDraw
one_liner: Free open-license SVG/PNG illustrations with live color editing to match your brand.
reason: Free for commercial use with no attribution. Handy for portfolio empty states, about sections or client sites, though the style is common in SaaS designs.

name: vanilla-tilt.js
one_liner: Lightweight dependency-free JavaScript library for 3D tilt, glare and parallax hover effects on elements.
reason: An easy, framework-agnostic tilt effect for project thumbnails and cards. flutter_tilt is for Flutter, so this is the web equivalent, not a duplicate.

name: Web Design Museum
one_liner: Archive of thousands of screenshots of real websites, apps and Flash games from 1991 to 2006.
reason: Bot protection returns 403, but search confirms the site is live. A real-world reference for retro and Y2K-style portfolios, alongside the library's style guides.

name: Blobmaker
one_liner: Free generator for random organic SVG blob shapes with complexity and contrast controls.
reason: duplicate of haikei

name: Get Waves
one_liner: Free SVG wave section-divider generator with a Figma plugin, now folded into Haikei.
reason: duplicate of haikei

name: Aesthetics Wiki
one_liner: Community Fandom wiki of about 1,200 pages on named aesthetics, subcultures, fashion styles and internet visual trends.
reason: Blocked to fetch (403/402) though live per search; ad-heavy fan wiki leaning fashion and subculture, weaker for web art direction than CARI already in the library.

name: ComfyUI
one_liner: Open-source node-based canvas for image and video diffusion pipelines, with desktop, cloud and workflow-as-API offerings.
reason: A heavy, technical, general-purpose generative media pipeline; far more than most portfolio builders need, and Figma Weave already covers node-based AI imagery.

name: FLORA
one_liner: AI creative workspace combining 50+ image and video models on one canvas with reusable workflow Techniques.
reason: Aimed at brand teams and agencies producing assets at scale; tangential to building a portfolio and overlaps the existing Figma Weave record.

name: Luma Dream Machine (Luma Agents)
one_liner: Paid AI workspace for generating and editing images, video and audio on a canvas; plans from $30/month.
reason: Live, but paid only with no free tier and only marginal use for portfolios. Its AI hero-footage niche is already covered by Higgsfield.

name: Midlibrary
one_liner: Catalog of 5,500+ artistic styles and 4,000 SREF codes with sample outputs for Midjourney prompting.
reason: Live, but made for Midjourney image prompting rather than building portfolio websites, so it's only loosely relevant.

name: mymind
one_liner: Private AI-tagged bookmarking and notes app for saving articles, images and links, searchable by color or keyword.
reason: Live, but a general personal-memory app rather than a design resource. Cosmos already covers collecting visual references.

name: Nicelydone
one_liner: Searchable library of 203,000+ screenshots and 12,800+ flows from 500+ SaaS web apps, with a free tier.
reason: SaaS in-app screens rarely inform portfolio site design, and the reference role is already covered by Refero and Mobbin in the library.

name: Page Flows
one_liner: Paid library of annotated screen recordings of real app user flows across iOS, Android and web.
reason: Focused on product app flows like onboarding and checkout, not portfolio site design; paid, and it overlaps existing Mobbin and Refero records.

name: Rijksmuseum Collection
one_liner: The Rijksmuseum's online collection portal for browsing Dutch art and objects.
reason: A general museum portal, not a design resource; the fetched page did not confirm download licensing. The Public Domain Image Archive covers reusable imagery better.

name: Screensdesign
one_liner: Library of top-chart iOS app screens, onboarding flows, paywalls and revenue estimates with design teardowns.
reason: Aimed at iOS app onboarding and paywall research, not portfolio websites. Mobbin already covers mobile UI reference.

name: SpinKit
one_liner: Twelve pure-CSS loading spinners with copy-paste HTML and CSS by Tobias Ahlin, open source on GitHub.
reason: Old, small set of generic loaders. Portfolio sites rarely need spinners, and Math Curve Loaders already covers the niche.

name: The Casual Optimist
one_liner: Active book cover design blog with monthly roundups of notable covers and designer spotlights.
reason: Live and active, but focused on print book covers. Little direct use for building a web portfolio; the library already covers this niche with Book Cover Archive.

name: Theatre.js
one_liner: Apache-2.0 JavaScript animation library with a visual keyframe and graph editor for DOM and Three.js motion.
reason: Site is live, but the last npm release was May 2024 and the repo has had no push since August 2024; niche next to GSAP and Motion.

name: Tokyo Type Directors Club
one_liner: Annual Japanese typography and graphic design awards. The official site now appears to live at tokyotypedirectorsclub.org.
reason: The given domain now shows an unrelated Japanese title, and the official archive has moved. Print and typographic awards are only loosely related to building web portfolios.

name: zeroheight
one_liner: Platform that documents design systems, syncing with Figma, Storybook and code repos, with an MCP server for agents.
reason: Aimed at enterprise design system teams. Far more than anyone needs to build a personal or small-studio portfolio.

name: Frontify
one_liner: Enterprise brand guidelines and digital asset management platform with AI tagging, templates and MCP/API access.
reason: Enterprise DAM sold via demos with no public free plan; not something an individual or small studio would use to build a portfolio site.
